response.text: Invoice 328 has an AP/GL mismatch (journal balanced but different from the invoice amount). Next I'll check the payment journals, duplicate payments, and other checks.

arguments.sql: select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", x.dr2000, x.cr1000, x.n from "APPAYM" p left join "GLJRNH" h on h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" left join (select "JRNL_NO", sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "DR_AMT" end) dr2000, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='1000' then "CR_AMT" end) cr1000, count(*) n from "GLJRNL" group by 1) x on x."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or coalesce(x.dr2000,-1)<>p."PAY_AMT" or coalesce(x.cr1000,-1)<>p."PAY_AMT"
select "INV_ID", count(*), array_agg("PAY_ID") from "APPAYM" group by 1 having count(*)>1
select h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF" like 'PAY-%' and h."SRC_REF" not in (select 'PAY-'||"PAY_ID" from "APPAYM")

select i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_DT", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", h."SRC_REF", i."INV_NO", i."VEND_CD" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where h."SRC_REF"<>i."INV_NO" or h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" or left(i."INV_NO",5)<>trim(i."VEND_CD") or h."PRD_ID"<>(substr(i."INV_DT"::text,5,2))::int
